_comment: moderner line, MC 1.21.10, fabric (the checkout's fabric-legacy module). fabric-api version is fabric_version in moderner/gradle.properties; the fabric variant needs it (1.21.10 fabric.mod.json declares the legacy "fabric": "*" + the common code is compiled against fabric-api). Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/moderner-1.21.10-fabric, an independent loom build in this repository) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test: jt resolves and pins, builds/reuses the JECh jar from the moderner checkout's fabric-legacy module and compiles the harness build, then launches that build's runClient with the jars under test as -PjechJar/-PjeiJar. The client drives its own scenarios and writes report.json, its captures and junit.xml before it quits itself. Three consequences carried over from the checkout-backend shape: the row declares no ready_when (stopping this client early would kill it mid-scenario and leave no report), no world (the level asserted against is the one the harness's runner creates and pins itself, so the JEI plugin marker still arrives), and no gradle block (the harness build is the launch layer). jech, jei and fabric-api all carry via=dev-classpath: the harness build stages the two jars under test into the run's mods/ folder itself (production fabric jars are intermediary-named; the loader's dev-mode remapper brings them into the run's namespace) and takes fabric-api as its own remapped Gradle dependency at exactly the pinned version, so there is nothing for jt to stage.
